title: Login button does nothing on Safari
description: Clicking the login button on the sign-in page has no effect in Safari 17.
steps_to_reproduce:
Open https://app.example.com/login in Safari 17
Enter a valid email and password
Click Login
expected_result: The user is signed in and redirected to the dashboard.
actual_result: Nothing happens; the console shows TypeError: undefined is not a function.

actual_result: There is no Logout link in the menu.

title: Cart total ignores discount code
description: Applying the SAVE10 code shows a success message but the total is unchanged.
steps_to_reproduce:
Add any product to the cart
Enter SAVE10 in the discount field
Click Apply
expected_result: The cart total is reduced by 10%.
actual_result: A success toast appears but the total stays at the original price.
